label: Experience
description: Entry point for recorded conversation experience in a language.
criterion: At least one saved learner message. This records participation, not assessed proficiency.

label: Expression
description: Convey a simple meaningful statement about something familiar.
criterion: A listener can recover at least one intended fact, need or preference.

label: Identification
description: Identify people, objects and familiar information in a simple exchange.
criterion: The intended person, object or fact is identifiable from the response and context.

label: Distinguish referents
description: Differentiate similar people, objects or facts using relevant distinguishing details.
criterion: Differentiate similar people, objects or facts using relevant distinguishing details. Credit only evidence in the current learner message with enough supplied context to judge this demand.

label: Relate information
description: Explain how identifiable people, objects or facts relate to each other.
criterion: Explain how identifiable people, objects or facts relate to each other. Credit only evidence in the current learner message with enough supplied context to judge this demand.

label: Precise characterization
description: Characterize a referent using accurate qualifications and context-sensitive detail.
criterion: Characterize a referent using accurate qualifications and context-sensitive detail. Credit only evidence in the current learner message with enough supplied context to judge this demand.

label: Needs & preferences
description: Express an immediate need or a clear preference relevant to the exchange.
criterion: The listener can identify what is needed, liked or disliked. No particular grammatical form is required.

label: Prioritize needs
description: Rank competing needs or preferences and explain the trade-off.
criterion: Rank competing needs or preferences and explain the trade-off. Credit only evidence in the current learner message with enough supplied context to judge this demand.

label: Conditional preferences
description: State how a preference changes with a relevant condition or constraint.
criterion: State how a preference changes with a relevant condition or constraint. Credit only evidence in the current learner message with enough supplied context to judge this demand.

label: Reconcile preferences
description: Develop a workable choice that reconciles competing preferences.
criterion: Develop a workable choice that reconciles competing preferences. Credit only evidence in the current learner message with enough supplied context to judge this demand.

label: Connected discourse
description: Connect descriptions or events into an account a listener can follow.
criterion: Relationships and sequence are clear enough to reconstruct the intended account.

label: Multiple perspectives
description: Integrate differing perspectives into a coherent account without confusing their sources.
criterion: Integrate differing perspectives into a coherent account without confusing their sources. Credit only evidence in the current learner message with enough supplied context to judge this demand.

label: Complex time relations
description: Communicate nontrivial temporal relationships clearly, without requiring a particular tense system.
criterion: Communicate nontrivial temporal relationships clearly, without requiring a particular tense system. Credit only evidence in the current learner message with enough supplied context to judge this demand.

label: Synthesize accounts
description: Combine information from several supplied accounts into a coherent synthesis without inventing facts.
criterion: Combine information from several supplied accounts into a coherent synthesis without inventing facts. Credit only evidence in the current learner message with enough supplied context to judge this demand.

label: Interaction
description: Take part in a simple exchange with another speaker.
criterion: A context-relevant contribution initiates or continues the exchange.

label: Basic interaction
description: Respond to a simple turn and maintain a short exchange.
criterion: The response is relevant and allows the exchange to continue. Supplied wording counts as assistance.

label: Manage turns
description: Coordinate entry, continuation or closure in an extended exchange using context-appropriate signals.
criterion: Coordinate entry, continuation or closure in an extended exchange using context-appropriate signals. Credit only evidence in the current learner message with enough supplied context to judge this demand.

label: Develop an exchange
description: Ask a substantive follow-up that develops the other speaker’s meaning beyond a routine response.
criterion: Ask a substantive follow-up that develops the other speaker’s meaning beyond a routine response. Credit only evidence in the current learner message with enough supplied context to judge this demand.

label: Respond to implied intent
description: Respond appropriately to an indirectly expressed intention supported by the available context.
criterion: Respond appropriately to an indirectly expressed intention supported by the available context. Credit only evidence in the current learner message with enough supplied context to judge this demand.

label: Clarification & repair
description: Resolve ambiguity or a misunderstanding during an exchange.
criterion: A clarification request or reformulation addresses the actual misunderstanding.

label: Locate misunderstanding
description: Identify the specific source of a misunderstanding and check the intended interpretation.
criterion: Identify the specific source of a misunderstanding and check the intended interpretation. Credit only evidence in the current learner message with enough supplied context to judge this demand.

label: Strategic reformulation
description: Resolve a persistent misunderstanding by changing the explanatory approach, not merely repeating wording.
criterion: Resolve a persistent misunderstanding by changing the explanatory approach, not merely repeating wording. Credit only evidence in the current learner message with enough supplied context to judge this demand.

label: Verify shared meaning
description: Check and establish agreement about a consequential ambiguity after clarification.
criterion: Check and establish agreement about a consequential ambiguity after clarification. Credit only evidence in the current learner message with enough supplied context to judge this demand.

label: Argument & negotiation
description: Engage with competing positions and negotiate an outcome.
criterion: The response addresses competing constraints or objections and develops a coherent position.

label: Address counterarguments
description: Respond substantively to a competing argument while accurately representing its strongest relevant point.
criterion: Respond substantively to a competing argument while accurately representing its strongest relevant point. Credit only evidence in the current learner message with enough supplied context to judge this demand.

label: Develop compromise
description: Propose a workable compromise that explicitly handles competing constraints.
criterion: Propose a workable compromise that explicitly handles competing constraints. Credit only evidence in the current learner message with enough supplied context to judge this demand.

label: Resolve disagreement
description: Move an exchange toward a clear agreed outcome or precise remaining disagreement without obscuring differences.
criterion: Move an exchange toward a clear agreed outcome or precise remaining disagreement without obscuring differences. Credit only evidence in the current learner message with enough supplied context to judge this demand.

label: Understanding & mediation
description: Show understanding of an explicit message by responding to or relaying its meaning.
criterion: The response shows accurate understanding of identifiable source material; do not infer comprehension merely from fluent output.

label: Explanation
description: Explain a view, preference or decision with relevant reasons.
criterion: Reasons support the intended point and are understandable in context.

label: Explain causal limits
description: Distinguish a supported explanation from alternatives or limits without overstating causation.
criterion: Distinguish a supported explanation from alternatives or limits without overstating causation. Credit only evidence in the current learner message with enough supplied context to judge this demand.

label: Weigh explanations
description: Compare plausible reasons and justify their relative relevance to the question.
criterion: Compare plausible reasons and justify their relative relevance to the question. Credit only evidence in the current learner message with enough supplied context to judge this demand.

label: Layer an explanation
description: Develop a coherent multi-step explanation with enough signposting for the listener to follow.
criterion: Develop a coherent multi-step explanation with enough signposting for the listener to follow. Credit only evidence in the current learner message with enough supplied context to judge this demand.

label: Nuance & stance
description: Express qualifications, uncertainty and distinctions of viewpoint precisely.
criterion: The response preserves relevant distinctions without overstating certainty.

label: Calibrate certainty
description: Match strength of a claim to explicitly available evidence and acknowledge consequential uncertainty.
criterion: Match strength of a claim to explicitly available evidence and acknowledge consequential uncertainty. Credit only evidence in the current learner message with enough supplied context to judge this demand.

label: Distinguish stances
description: Separate the learner’s stance from attributed positions and preserve relevant nuance.
criterion: Separate the learner’s stance from attributed positions and preserve relevant nuance. Credit only evidence in the current learner message with enough supplied context to judge this demand.

label: Interpret implications
description: Explain a defensible implication or ambiguity in supplied material while distinguishing it from explicit content.
criterion: Explain a defensible implication or ambiguity in supplied material while distinguishing it from explicit content. Credit only evidence in the current learner message with enough supplied context to judge this demand.

label: Audience & mediation
description: Adapt and relay meaning for another audience or purpose.
criterion: Important meaning is preserved while explanation and register suit the intended audience.

label: Adapt register
description: Re-express supplied meaning in a register suitable for a specified audience without losing essential content.
criterion: Re-express supplied meaning in a register suitable for a specified audience without losing essential content. Credit only evidence in the current learner message with enough supplied context to judge this demand.

label: Bridge assumptions
description: Explain an assumption or culturally situated reference needed by a specified audience, without stereotyping or invention.
criterion: Explain an assumption or culturally situated reference needed by a specified audience, without stereotyping or invention. Credit only evidence in the current learner message with enough supplied context to judge this demand.

label: Mediate multiple sources
description: Select and integrate relevant meaning from multiple supplied sources for a particular audience or purpose.
criterion: Select and integrate relevant meaning from multiple supplied sources for a particular audience or purpose. Credit only evidence in the current learner message with enough supplied context to judge this demand.
